main.remarks: Supplies signing metadata and produces signature bytes for signed access-key envelope creation.

method.name: GetSigningInfo
method.summary: Get the signing metadata required for signed access-key envelope creation.
method.param: Signing context for the current operation, including diagnostics infrastructure and any currently known issuance facts.
method.returns: Signing metadata for the current signer configuration.

method.name: TrySign
method.summary: Try to sign a canonical access-key envelope byte region into the supplied signature buffer.
method.param: Signing context for the current operation, including the canonical signed-region bytes and optional logger.
Destination signature buffer sized according to .
Number of signature bytes written to the destination buffer.
method.returns: True when signing succeeded; otherwise false.
